last_post_text:
Destinies are written in ink, but humanity is forged in blood. To stand amid a storm of cruel gods with a heavy blade and still take another step—that is not madness. We do not struggle to conquer fate; we struggle to remind the darkness that even in the deepest black, a human soul refuses to go out.
